findings.message: Timing Attack vulnerability in secret/signature comparison (CWE-208): Using the standard '==' operator to compare cryptographic digests, API tokens, or HMAC signatures leaks byte-by-byte timing information. Use a constant-time comparison function instead of '==' or '!='.
findings.issue_text: Timing Attack vulnerability in secret/signature comparison (CWE-208): Using the standard '==' operator to compare cryptographic digests, API tokens, or HMAC signatures leaks byte-by-byte timing information. Use a constant-time comparison function instead of '==' or '!='.
